boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute
boards.description: Ten currently listed, under-21-safe Troy destinations with food or a non-alcohol-centered evening activity available into the night.

cards.title: I Love New York Pizza
cards.subtitle: 125 4th Street, Troy
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm availability before leaving; it identifies this downtown pizza shop as open until 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza pickup or delivery option with late-night availability listed by the business.
cards.evidence_claim: The business states it is open until 1 a.m. and offers pickup and delivery from 125 4th Street.
cards.source_title: I Love New York Pizza of Troy — official site
cards.access_notes: Official site says the restaurant is open until 1 a.m.; confirm the current ordering window before travel.

cards.title: City Deli Market
cards.subtitle: 2810 5th Avenue, Troy
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: the market lists midnight closing most days and 1 a.m. closing on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.short_summary: A Troy deli and market whose posted hours extend past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: City Deli Market lists hours until midnight Sunday through Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted business hours: midnight most days; 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Wendy's on Vandenburgh Avenue
cards.subtitle: 77 Vandenburgh Avenue, Troy
cards.notes: This is a drive-thru-friendly option farther from campus; verify service mode in the official locator before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A chain restaurant with officially posted restaurant and drive-thru hours into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours through 2 a.m. daily and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday at this Troy location.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists restaurant and drive-thru open until 2 a.m.; Friday and Saturday until 3 a.m.

cards.title: Amante Pizza
cards.subtitle: 2301 15th Street, Troy
cards.notes: Use Amante's live ordering page before you go; it identifies the Troy location and currently shows a 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A pizza, shawarma, and sub shop with an official online-ordering window late into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Amante's official Toast ordering page lists its 2301 15th Street Troy location as open until 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page currently states “Closes at 1AM”; ordering availability can change.

cards.title: Herbie's Burgers
cards.subtitle: Troy location
cards.notes: Check the official ordering page on the night you plan to go; it lists the Troy restaurant's ordering window through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A burger-and-sides stop with an official late ordering window.
cards.evidence_claim: Herbie's official ordering page lists a Troy location and shows hours from 11 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists 11 a.m.–midnight; check for day-specific changes before travel.

cards.title: Nighthawks
cards.subtitle: 461 Broadway, Troy
cards.notes: For a later dinner rather than a midnight run, use the restaurant's posted 10 p.m. food schedule and reserve if needed.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway restaurant whose official page lists food service through 10 p.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Nighthawks lists food hours until 10 p.m. Monday through Sunday at 461 Broadway.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists food service until 10 p.m. daily and notes that reservations are recommended.

cards.title: Sunhee's Farm and Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 95–97 Ferry Street, Troy
cards.notes: Plan this one for Friday or Saturday evening: the restaurant's official visit page lists service until 10 p.m. and takeout or delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Ferry Street restaurant with late Friday and Saturday hours plus takeout and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunhee's lists Friday and Saturday business hours until 10 p.m. and says takeout and delivery are available.
cards.source_title: Sunhee's Farm and Kitchen — visit information
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday–Saturday service until 10 p.m.; it is closed Sunday through Wednesday.

cards.title: Union Seafood
cards.subtitle: 120 Hoosick Street, Troy
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday stop when possible; the official site lists carryout and dine-in service through 10:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Hoosick Street seafood and hibachi restaurant with the latest posted hours on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Union Seafood lists Friday and Saturday business and carryout hours from 11 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday carryout through 10:30 p.m.; other open days end at 10 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Asian Pan Chinese and Japanese Restaurant
cards.title: Asian Pan
cards.subtitle: 4 Northern Drive, Troy
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's official order page to check availability; Friday, Saturday, and Sunday are posted later than weekday service.
cards.short_summary: A Chinese, Japanese, and Thai restaurant with 10:30 p.m. weekend closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Asian Pan lists Friday and Saturday hours until 10:30 p.m. and Sunday hours until 10:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Asian Pan Chinese and Japanese Restaurant — official ordering site
cards.access_notes: Official site posts 10:30 p.m. closing Friday through Sunday; Monday–Thursday close at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Bard & Baker Board Game Café
cards.subtitle: 501 Broadway, Troy
cards.notes: For an alcohol-optional evening activity, arrive before the kitchen's posted 9 p.m. close and use the café's game-focused space until 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A board-game café open until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday, with food service ending earlier.
cards.evidence_claim: Bard & Baker lists Friday and Saturday store hours until 11 p.m., with the kitchen closing at 9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Bard & Baker Board Game Café — contact and hours
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; kitchen closes at 9 p.m. Check event availability.
